biography_summary: 杰弗里·迈尔斯·布莱德纳（Jeffrey Miles Blidner），1948年3月19日出生于加拿大安大略省多伦多，加拿大籍律师、金融家，现任博枫公司（Brookfield Corporation）副主席兼董事。Blidner本科毕业于西安大略大学获文学学士学位（1969年），后就读于奥斯古德霍尔法学院获法学学士学位（1972年），1974年获安大略省律师资格并以金牌奖章毕业。职业生涯早期，Blidner在多伦多知名律师事务所Goodman & Carr LLP担任高级合伙人，执业专注于商人银行业务、公开发售、并购、管理层收购、企业重组及私募股权交易，同时担任安大略省律师协会和加拿大律师协会的公司与商法讲师。2000年加入Brookfield，最初负责战略规划和交易执行，后逐步晋升为集团核心管理层成员。Blidner曾担任Brookfield私募基金集团CEO，主导面向私人客户的基金募集和投资业务。现任Brookfield Corporation副主席兼董事、Brookfield Renewable Partners董事长、Brookfield Business Partners董事长，同时在Brookfield Infrastructure Partners和Brookfield Asset Management Ltd.担任董事。他还担任多伦多Baycrest老年护理中心董事长，致力于老年医疗和脑健康研究事业。据MarketScreener估计，其公开持股价值约7.25亿美元。

collection_meta.notes: Profile of Jeffrey Blidner, Vice Chair of Brookfield Corporation. Full name: Jeffrey Miles Blidner. Canadian nationality. Born March 19, 1948 in Toronto, Ontario (confirmed from prabook.com). Education: BA from University of Western Ontario (1969), LLB from Osgoode Hall Law School (1972), called to Ontario Bar in 1974 as Gold Medalist. Prior career: Senior Partner at Goodman & Carr LLP (Toronto law firm), practice focused on merchant banking, public offerings, M&A, management buyouts, restructurings, private equity. Lecturer for Law Society of Upper Canada and Canadian Bar Association. Joined Brookfield in 2000. Former CEO of Brookfield Private Funds Group. Former Chairman of Soundvest Split Trust, Brascan SoundVest, and Transelec SA. Former Director of Tricon Residential and AT&T Canada Enterprises. Director of Brookfield Corporation since May 2013. Age 78 per MarketScreener (as of 2026). Net worth ~$725M per MarketScreener based on public holdings. No Wikipedia page. No Wikidata QID. No LinkedIn or other social media found. No family members found in public sources. Baycrest Centre Chairman since September 2013.
